title: Return-Record Relief on Made-to-Order Work Charges — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Training Note
content:
**Rule.** Return-record relief applies to the work charge on a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation cancelled in production. It counts the return authorizations opened on the customer's profile in the last 12 months, whatever became of them. The count multiplies the work charge:

- none: **0.9**;
- one up to 2: **0.95**;
- more than 2: **1.0**.

The relief multiplies the work charge as one more factor of the same product of the reserved price and the work share. It applies before the cap at the deposit held and before the rounding to the cent, both of which apply to the whole product.

**Questions and answers**

*Which records are counted?*
Return authorizations under Returns & Exchanges opened on the customer's profile. Each one is counted by the date it was opened.

*Does a return that was later rejected, withdrawn or closed still count?*
Yes. Every return authorization opened in the last 12 months counts, whatever became of it.

*A customer opened a return 13 months ago and none since. What applies?*
No return authorization was opened in the last 12 months, so the count is none and the multiplier is 0.9.

*Two returns were opened this year. What applies?*
Two is within "one up to 2", so the multiplier is 0.95.

*Three were opened?*
Three is more than 2, so the multiplier is 1.0.

| Return authorizations opened, last 12 months | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 or more |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Work charge multiplied by | 0.9 | 0.95 | 0.95 | 1.0 | 1.0 |
